description_en: Query statistics of each member in a job
description_zh: 查询任务中各成员的统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun openitag get-task-workforce-statistic --tenant-id GA000W134 --task-id 15400008306500608 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --stat-type ITEM --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTaskWorkforceStatistic

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454649.html
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The job ID. For information about how to obtain a job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454662.html
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the member list. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 任务成员列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of members per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的任务成员数量，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The statistics type. Valid values:
ITEM: Statistics are collected based on individual review records.
OPERATORCELL: Statistics are collected based on operation units. A single ITEM may contain multiple operation units
parameters.help_zh:
统计类型，取值如下：
ITEM：按照单条审核记录。
OPERATORCELL：按照操作单元，一个ITEM可能会包含多个操作单元
parameters.name: stat_type
